sources.title: TriStar MPPT MODBUS Specification
sources.relevance: Authoritative Modbus RTU/TCP parameters, register addresses, scaling, functions, network registers, EEPROM fields, coils, alarms, faults, and device-identification behavior.

sources.title: Morningstar Product Connectivity Manual - Networking & Communications
sources.relevance: Cross-product communications reference covering RS-232, USB, MeterBus, Modbus networks, local/remote connections, HTTP, SNMP, data logging, network security, and troubleshooting.

sources.title: TriStar MPPT Networking Companion Document
sources.relevance: Legacy but useful details for DHCP, LAN connectivity, Ethernet-enabled TriStar MPPT models, local discovery, and remote access.

sources.title: RSC-1 RS-232 to EIA-485 Communications Adapter Installation and Operation Manual
sources.relevance: Adapter wiring and serial characteristics for RS-232/USB-to-RS-232 clients connected to Morningstar EIA-485 networks.

sources.title: TriStar MPPT Installation, Operation and Maintenance Manual
sources.relevance: Controller operating behavior, faults/alarms, and communications chapters for MeterBus, RS-232, EIA-485, and Ethernet.

sources.title: TriStar MPPT Meter Map - Solar Charging
sources.relevance: Human-facing names for operating values, diagnostics, alarms, faults, charge states, counters, settings, and logged data.

sources.title: Using a TriStar MPPT for Bridged Communication on a Morningstar EIA-485 Network
sources.relevance: Architecture reference for Modbus/TCP bridging from a TS-MPPT-60 to multiple Modbus devices on an EIA-485 bus.

sources.title: TriStar MPPT Product Page
sources.relevance: Canonical product landing page linking the current manuals, meter map, Modbus document, firmware, and support resources.
